title: Example open research problem
abstract: Resolve a precise mathematical boundary case.
background: All terms in the problem statement are fixed and defined.
previous_progress: A restricted case has been solved.
problem_statement: Prove or disprove P for every object in C.

mathematics.description: Determines whether method M extends to the full class C.

solution_difficulty: Known local arguments do not compose over C.

proof.contract: Accept a complete proof of P for every object in C.

counterexample.contract: Accept an explicit object in C for which P fails.
counterexample.ci_contract: Parse the object, check membership in C, and check failure of P.

verification_difficulty.rationale: Counterexamples are mechanically checkable; a general proof requires connected expert review.
